name: helm-chart
author: Codesphere

repoUrl.description: Git repository URL containing the Helm chart

targetRevision.description: Git branch, tag, or commit SHA

path.description: Path to Helm chart within the repository

helmValues.description: Helm values to override (non-sensitive) as JSON string

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the release is deployed

status.description: Current status of the Helm release

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the release was created

sensitiveHelmValues.description: Sensitive Helm values (e.g., passwords, API keys) as JSON string

description:
Deploy any Helm chart from a Git repository to Kubernetes.
Supports both shared cluster and custom cluster deployment modes.
Ideal for deploying containerized applications, databases, and infrastructure components.
